**DJ942** is a medical diagnosis code designating haemothorax (blood in the pleural cavity). Within the context of the Danish healthcare system's clinical quality databases, it serves as a specific diagnostic identifier used to track complications in patients with [[atrieflimren]]. 

Specifically, DJ942 is one of several codes utilized to calculate the incidence of [[alvorlig-bloedning|Alvorlig blødning]] (severe bleeding) among atrial fibrillation patients [^src1]. The clinical indicator for severe bleeding relies on a broad spectrum of diagnoses to capture different bleeding events, including intracranial, gastrointestinal, and urinary or respiratory tract hemorrhages [^src1]. DJ942 is grouped alongside codes like [[dn02|DN02]], [[dr04|DR04]], and [[dr31|DR31]] to specifically identify and quantify urinary and respiratory tract bleeding events [^src1]. 

This coding definition has remained consistent across multiple annual reporting cycles of the Atrial Fibrillation Database in Denmark (AFDK). It appears in the methodology and indicator definitions of the 2023, 2024, and 2025 annual reports [^src1] [^src2] [^src3]. By standardizing these diagnostic codes, the Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram (RKKP) ensures uniform data collection, enabling reliable quality measurement and comparison across Danish regions.

## Claims
- For incidens af alvorlig blødning anvendes en bred vifte af diagnoser, herunder DI60–DS066 for intrakraniel blødning, DK25.0–DK29.8A og DK92.0–DK92.2 for gastrointestinal blødning samt DJ942, DN02, DR04 og DR31 for urinvejs-/lunge blødning [^src1] (di60, di61, di62, ds064, ds065, ds066, dk25-0, dk25-2, dk25-4, dk25-6, dk26-0, dk26-2, dk26-4, dk26-6, dk27-0, dk27-2, dk27-4, dk27-6, dk28-0, dk28-2, dk28-4, dk28-6, dk29-0, dk29-8a, dk92-0, dk92-1, dk92-2, dj942, dn02, dr04, dr31) [^src1]
